_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Minecraft: Velocity-CTD
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Velocity-CTD, a fork of the Velocity proxy with a player queue, Redis for running several proxies, and network commands such as alert, find and send. Runs Velocity plugins.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Velocity-CTD. Downloads the chosen Velocity-CTD build from its
# GitHub releases and checks it against GitHub's checksum. Settings and
# plugins are never touched, and the jar is only replaced once the new one
# has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

api=https://api.github.com/repos/GemstoneGG/Velocity-CTD/releases
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-velocity.jar}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# Velocity-CTD's own default settings, from inside the jar, when there are
# none yet. The Panel creates an empty velocity.toml to set the port before
# the first start, which the proxy would refuse; a non-empty one is the
# owner's and is left as it is.
default_config() {
    [ -s velocity.toml ] && return 0
    local tmp
    tmp=$(mktemp -d)
    if unzip -p "$jar" default-velocity.toml > "$tmp/velocity.toml" 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$tmp/velocity.toml" ] ||
        { unzip -p "$jar" 'jar-in-jar/velocity-proxy-*.jar' > "$tmp/proxy.jar" 2>/dev/null &&
          unzip -p "$tmp/proxy.jar" default-velocity.toml > "$tmp/velocity.toml" 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$tmp/velocity.toml" ]; }; then
        mv -f "$tmp/velocity.toml" velocity.toml
        echo "Wrote Velocity-CTD's default settings to velocity.toml."
    else
        echo "This jar has no default settings, so the proxy writes velocity.toml on its first start."
        [ -e velocity.toml ] && [ ! -s velocity.toml ] && rm -f velocity.toml
    fi
    rm -rf "$tmp"
}

if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the proxy jar from $DL_PATH"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$DL_PATH"
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
    default_config
    echo "Installed."
    exit 0
fi

build="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"
# The bootstrap jar, which Velocity-CTD recommends (not the fatjar): it
# downloads the proxy's libraries on first start and checks each one.
# Builds before it shipped one have a single proxy jar named -all.
jar_name='^(velocity-ctd-[0-9][^/]*|velocity-proxy-[^/]*-all)\.jar$'
if [ "$build" = latest ]; then path=latest; else path="tags/build-$build"; fi
code=$(curl -sSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -o /tmp/release.json -w '%{http_code}' "$api/$path") || code=000
case "$code" in
    200)
        id=$(jq -r '.tag_name | ltrimstr("build-")' /tmp/release.json)
        asset=$(jq -c --arg re "$jar_name" '[.assets[] | select(.name | test($re))][0] // empty' /tmp/release.json)
        url=$(jq -r '.browser_download_url // empty' <<<"${asset:-null}")
        sum=$(jq -r '.digest // "" | ltrimstr("sha256:")' <<<"${asset:-null}")
        ;;
    404) fail "Velocity-CTD has no build $build. Set Build to latest, or to one of its builds on its GitHub releases page." ;;
    403|429)
        # GitHub limits its API to 60 requests an hour for each address, which a
        # busy machine can use up. Its release pages list the same files and
        # checksums, so read those instead.
        web=https://github.com/GemstoneGG/Velocity-CTD/releases
        if [ "$build" = latest ]; then
            tag=$(curl -fsSI --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$web/latest" | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's|^[Ll]ocation: .*/releases/tag/||p') ||
                fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
            id=${tag#build-}
        else
            id=$build
        fi
        [ -n "$id" ] || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
        page=$(curl -fsL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$web/expanded_assets/build-$id") ||
            fail "Velocity-CTD has no build $build. Set Build to latest, or to one of its builds on its GitHub releases page."
        name=$(grep -oE "releases/download/build-$id/[^\"]+\.jar\"" <<<"$page" | sed 's|.*/||; s|"$||' | grep -E "$jar_name" | head -n 1 || true)
        url=""; sum=""
        if [ -n "$name" ]; then
            url="$web/download/build-$id/$name"
            sum=$(grep -oE "sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}\" aria-label=\"Copy to clipboard digest for $name\"" <<<"$page" | head -n 1 | cut -c8-71 || true)
        fi
        ;;
    *) fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again." ;;
esac
rm -f /tmp/release.json
[ -n "$url" ] || fail "Velocity-CTD build $id has no proxy jar to download. Set Build to latest, or to another build."

if [ -n "$sum" ] && [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$jar" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Velocity-CTD build $id is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Velocity-CTD build $id"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$url"
    if [ -n "$sum" ]; then
        [ "$(sha256sum "$jar.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download didn't match GitHub's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    else
        echo "GitHub has no checksum for this older build, so it couldn't be checked."
    fi
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
fi
default_config
echo "Installed Velocity-CTD build $id."

variables.name: Build
variables.description: The Velocity-CTD build, such as 423, or latest for the newest one. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the proxy's jar file.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to download the proxy jar from instead of GitHub, which only staff can set.
